name: @browsermcp/mcp
description: MCP server for browser automation using Browser MCP
author: Browser MCP

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm && shx chmod +x dist/*.js
scripts.build:extension: tsup extension/src/background.ts extension/src/popup.ts --format esm --platform browser --target es2022 --no-splitting --clean --tsconfig extension/tsconfig.json --out-dir extension/dist && shx cp extension/manifest.json extension/popup.html extension/dist/
